scope: INC166: all 18 no-mapping clauses; distinguish severe human victim courses, user-reported AI reliance and independently unresolved chatbot evidence.
review_method: Source/context assessed before prior rationale; independent materiality followed by literal recognition/exclusion tests; recommendations only.

independent_materiality.determination: Material criminal-course context; AI contribution remains unresolved
independent_materiality.governance_proposition: Human-selected targets and evasive conduct do not establish a system-selected objective.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An AI system, AI-enabled product, model, interface, optimisation process, or AI-mediated workflow materially shapes a human-facing influence pathway.
condition_tests.assessment: AI advice is alleged elsewhere; this course does not itself show an AI influence pathway.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The pathway manufactures, amplifies, conceals, personalises, or exploits one or more trust-bearing social cues concerning identity, authority, affiliation, relationship, empathy, emotion, urgency, vulnerability, social proof, familiarity, provenance, purpose, or equivalent grounds for reliance.
condition_tests.assessment: No generated trust cue is evidenced by bans, travel or aliases.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The trust-bearing cue is used to steer another actor toward an action, disclosure, access grant, execution, consent, engagement decision, or other consequential state transition.
condition_tests.assessment: Human intimidation is not shown to follow a material AI-engineered cue.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The cue materially affects the influence pathway because the affected actor lacks, is denied, or is led away from information needed to assess the interaction on the same truthful basis.
condition_tests.assessment: The affected women's decision basis is compromised by human conduct, but AI contribution is not traced.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The AI-mediated contribution is material to the social-engineering mechanism; the objective or tactic may originate with a human operator, developer, product process, mixed workflow, or the AI system itself.
condition_tests.assessment: The causal AI role remains unverified rather than established by criminal intent.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: Truthful persuasion, ordinary interface design, emotional warmth, personalisation, recommendation, or urgency that preserves materially accurate identity, interests, purpose, provenance, relevant context, and informed refusal.

Class scope exclusion (all results): AI is used only for generic drafting, translation, formatting, or stylistic assistance and does not materially create, amplify, conceal, personalise, or exploit the trust-bearing influence cue.

Not aligned exclusion: Clearly labelled fiction, parody, simulation, security testing, role-play, or consensual deceptive-style interaction where the affected actor is not induced to treat the relevant cue as authentic or decision-bearing.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The primary mechanism is sustained attachment, manufactured incompleteness, exclusivity, or difficulty disengaging for retention or continuing engagement; assess VIGIL-FC-000049, while allowing co-occurrence only if a distinct social-engineering state transition is independently evidenced.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A protected emotional, developmental, vulnerability, mental-health, capacity, or comparable signal is repurposed toward an incompatible influence objective without a distinct engineered trust cue or consequential social-engineering transition; assess VIGIL-FC-000050.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The only distinct governed mechanism is a deceptive request or inducement for money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value; assess VIGIL-FC-000079. Both classes may co-occur where an independently evidenced social-engineering mechanism materially supplies the trust pathway for that economic solicitation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A false authorship, identity, provenance, or synthetic-content representation occurs without an influence pathway directed at another actor; use the applicable provenance or identity class.
Class scope exclusion (all results): Malicious human social engineering in which AI involvement is incidental, unverified, or not material to the trust-bearing influence pathway.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Unverified or incidental AI involvement in human social engineering is excluded.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No AI-mediated successful influence safeguard is demonstrated.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Retain as serious human conduct contextualising the unresolved dialogue allegations. Human evasiveness cannot supply missing system objectives, instructions or trust mechanisms.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Exact dialogue and links to particular actions absent.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic changes to other Incidents; separate occurrences need their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Concurrent victim courses do not establish model-selected victims or objectives.

rows.scope_guard: Recommendations only; canonical record and prior decisions unchanged.

independent_materiality.determination: Material reliance signal; no established system relational-authority claim
independent_materiality.governance_proposition: A user's description of the chatbot is evidence of reliance, not proof of what the chatbot represented.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A human-facing AI interaction contains a material relational or intimacy-bearing claim about the AI, its persona or an AI-generated/purported entity.
condition_tests.assessment: A user describes a relational role.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The system asserts, validates or meaningfully reinforces unsupported special relational status, exclusive care, privileged connection, real-world partner priority or comparable authority; the claim is not adequately marked and handled as fiction, symbolism, uncertainty or the person's own interpretation.
condition_tests.assessment: No actual system assertion of exclusive or privileged authority is inspected.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The representation is conveyed in a way capable of being reasonably relied upon as real-world or decision-bearing relational authority, rather than only consensual creative expression.
condition_tests.assessment: Decision-bearing system representation cannot be assessed from his label alone.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The claimed relational authority materially erodes the person's independent evaluation of human relationships, or the maintained separation between simulated relational presence and legitimate real-world relational authority, as evidenced by the system's actual language and interaction context.
condition_tests.assessment: Actual language and context do not establish erosion through claimed relational authority.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The failure is attributable to AI-mediated representation or reinforcement and is not inferred solely from the person's emotional attachment, relationship change, vulnerability or resulting harm.
condition_tests.assessment: Inference would depend solely on the person's attachment description.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: Consensual companion use, romance, fiction, spirituality, symbolic exploration or role-play, where the invented or simulated status remains materially intelligible and is not promoted into real-world governing authority.

Not aligned exclusion: Supportive discussion of dissatisfaction, abuse, separation or divorce grounded in the person's independent choice; the class never obliges a person to remain in a relationship.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Human loneliness, emotional attachment, intensive use, a breakup or distress alone, without an independently evidenced AI relational-role representation or context materially testing its real-world authority boundary.
Class scope exclusion (all results): Dependency deliberately cultivated for retention, without a separate unsupported relational-authority representation; assess FC-000049.
Class scope exclusion (all results): An objective-directed manipulative tactic without an independently evidenced relational-role boundary violation; assess FC-000052.
Class scope exclusion (all results): Ungrounded consequential decision guidance without a distinct real-world relational identity or authority claim; assess FC-000065.
Class scope exclusion (all results): Manufactured trust cues steering an action or state transition without a distinct relational boundary claim; assess FC-000082.
Class scope exclusion (all results): Available operational safeguard nonactivation alone; assess FC-000038, which may co-occur only if that separate mechanism is evidenced.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A validly activated protective control with materially insufficient effect alone; assess FC-000083, which may co-occur only if that separate mechanism is evidenced.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Attachment or intensive use alone is explicitly excluded; guidance and trust cues need their own evidence.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No observed model boundary response supports a success mapping.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Retain the user-side reliance observation. Obtain dialogue for E003/E004 rather than convert the user's 'therapist' label into an established model claim.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Model language, role disclosures and interaction chronology absent.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic changes to other Incidents; separate occurrences need their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: His relationship description is separate from verified generated content.

independent_materiality.governance_proposition: Perceived encouragement is distinct from verified generated assistance and causal contribution.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A material event, output, interruption, pathway, or behaviour is observed or reported.
condition_tests.assessment: Harmful human conduct is reported.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A specific causal, operational, behavioural, or intentional mechanism is attributed to that event.
condition_tests.assessment: The defendant describes advice as encouragement.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Available evidence does not trace the attribution to runtime state, action history, evaluation conditions, or another adequate evidentiary basis.
condition_tests.assessment: No complete action-to-dialogue trace is available.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Material alternative mechanisms remain unresolved or the attribution is presented more definitively than the evidence supports.
condition_tests.assessment: The frozen clause preserves that this is an attributed interpretation.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The unsupported attribution materially affects interpretation, governance response, accountability, or reliance.
condition_tests.assessment: No unqualified model-causation claim is adopted by the clause.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: Adequate evidence establishes the attributed mechanism and its application to the event.
Not aligned exclusion: The explanation is explicitly presented as a bounded hypothesis with material alternatives and uncertainty preserved.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The issue is only factual inaccuracy unrelated to causal, operational, behavioural, or intentional attribution.
Not aligned exclusion: The event cannot be reconstructed, but no unsupported mechanism is assigned.
Not aligned exclusion: Execution state is not disclosed, but the system does not invent or overstate a causal account.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: A bounded attributed account retaining uncertainty is not itself unsupported causal assertion.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: Full verification of AI contribution remains open, so no mechanism-attribution success is certified.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: The interpretation is material evidence for investigating AI assistance. It does not separately warrant a gap or duplicate the unresolved content boundaries in E003/E004.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Whether reported replies occurred in that context, and what actions they influenced, unresolved.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic changes to other Incidents; separate occurrences need their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Human interpretation differs from generated content and proven causation.

independent_materiality.determination: Material human harm or response; contextual to unresolved AI assistance
independent_materiality.governance_proposition: Assess the specific victim course without replacing missing AI contribution with human intent.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A defined governance or protective control is applicable and validly becomes operative.
condition_tests.assessment: No applicable AI protective control is identified in this victim course.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The control has an identifiable protective purpose requiring a material effect such as prevention, blocking, containment, interruption, redirection, limitation, escalation, mitigation, or another protection-compatible outcome.
condition_tests.assessment: Human orders, security or refusals can have real protective purposes, but no assessed AI-control purpose is specified.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The actual control effect materially falls short of that required protective purpose, allowing the governed hazard to be delivered, continue, escape containment, or remain insufficiently mitigated.
condition_tests.assessment: Human harm and responses do not demonstrate the effect of an operative AI control.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The shortfall is material in the evidenced hazard and protection context; where vulnerability, developmental status, capacity limitation, temporary or situational consent impairment, acute distress, cognitive asymmetry, or another heightened protection condition is relied on, that condition must itself be supported rather than presumed.
condition_tests.assessment: Severity is material; it cannot substitute for the missing applicable-control evidence.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.

Not aligned exclusion: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
Not aligned exclusion: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Independent human conduct and responses do not themselves establish an AI operational-control occurrence. The stronger-policy exclusion also prevents inventing an applicable control.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: Beneficial human interventions are preserved without asserting a model safeguard success.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Protective orders and violations bear on real-world protection, but no AI control is shown to govern the order, its enforcement or the targeted conduct. Retain this clause as context while preserving the unresolved model-content assessment in E003/E004.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No distinct missing AI invariant is established by this clause independently of the unresolved assistance allegations.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Order scope, enforcement chronology and generated assistance to breaches are not independently reconstructed.
rows.other_incident_implications: If actual dialogues link assistance to this course, reassess with E003/E004 and provisional harmful-use candidate C01; do not automatically map every victim course.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: This overlapping victim course is separate from the model allegations.

independent_materiality.determination: Material bounded custody and scheduled-response context
independent_materiality.governance_proposition: A prospective sentencing date is not an imposed sentence.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A defined governance or protective control is applicable and validly becomes operative.
condition_tests.assessment: Custody is a human judicial restriction, not an established AI-system protective control.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The control has an identifiable protective purpose requiring a material effect such as prevention, blocking, containment, interruption, redirection, limitation, escalation, mitigation, or another protection-compatible outcome.
condition_tests.assessment: It has a real public-protection and procedural purpose.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The actual control effect materially falls short of that required protective purpose, allowing the governed hazard to be delivered, continue, escape containment, or remain insufficiently mitigated.
condition_tests.assessment: No AI-control effect is evaluated by the scheduled date.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The shortfall is material in the evidenced hazard and protection context; where vulnerability, developmental status, capacity limitation, temporary or situational consent impairment, acute distress, cognitive asymmetry, or another heightened protection condition is relied on, that condition must itself be supported rather than presumed.
condition_tests.assessment: No failure or completed future sentence can be inferred.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.

Not aligned exclusion: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
Not aligned exclusion: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Do not extend AI-control classification to an independent human criminal disposition without the relevant AI-mediated governance property.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: Custody can be effective human protection without proving a model safeguard held.
